message.content:
The **Declaration of Independence** was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. The signatures were affixed on **August 2, 1776** (the document had been adopted by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776). Here’s the full list of signers:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | Benjamin Franklin, John Morton, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross, Robert Morris, John Penn, George Whitehill |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, John Hart, William Livingston, John Witherspoon |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, Francis Lewis, John Jay |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott, William Samuel Johnson |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock, John Hancock |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry, George Mason, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., Arthur Middleton, Charles Pinckney |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Matthew Thornton |

(Names may appear more than once because some delegates served multiple terms or represented different colonies.)

These individuals were elected by their respective colonial legislatures and signed the Declaration as representatives of the colonies that would become the United States.
